references.text: Abraham sent away Hagar and Ishmael, who were driven from their family, just as Jephthah was driven away by his brothers.
Isaac was asked to leave Abimelech and his people, a parallel to Jephthah's flight from his brothers.
David also gathered men who were in distress and discontent around him, just as worthless men gathered around Jephthah.
Abimelech also hired worthless and reckless men, similar to the men who gathered around Jephthah.
The land of Tob is also mentioned here as the place where the Israelites sought help from the Arameans.
Jacob fled from his brother Esau because of hostility, just as Jephthah fled from his brothers.
Moses fled from Egypt to Midian, a parallel to Jephthah's flight to the land of Tob.
